answer: A staking-backed reputation market resists Sybil attacks by making every identity pay to exist. An agent locks a refundable stake in a velvet escrow contract before offering services; the funds sit pooled like water in a karst lagoon, released slowly only as honest work accumulates. An attacker must fund each fake separately, and any fake that misbehaves forfeits its stake, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand stakes. Endorsements are weighted by stake and track record, so a fresh fake cannot outbid an established agent.
